audio.sound_design: original procedural UI and route-transition SFX only

beats.headline: HVAC OWNERS / YOUR NEXT CUSTOMER / IS SCROLLING.
beats.action: Open immediately on a full-bleed HVAC website hero. No phone/device frame: the site fills the entire 1080x1920 canvas edge to edge. Warm hero photo, bright yellow/coral hook type, large Northline navigation and visible booking button.

beats.caption: COMFORT, BUILT AROUND YOU.
beats.action: Open the full-screen Home route; animate a visible vertical webpage scroll from a bold headline and CTA into a large HVAC photo and three vivid service cards.

beats.caption: HEATING. COOLING. FRESH AIR.
beats.action: Slide to a full-bleed Services route in saturated cobalt, with large high-contrast service cards and an edge-to-edge thermostat photo. Scroll the page to reveal its booking CTA.

beats.caption: A CLEARER PATH TO COMFORT.
beats.action: Open the full-screen How It Works route with a wide photo hero and three large numbered steps. Keep the page surface edge to edge and the copy comfortably readable.

beats.caption: CHOOSE A SERVICE. PICK A TIME.
beats.action: Open a full-screen Booking route. A cursor selects service, date and time, then taps Request a Visit; a clearly labeled sample confirmation appears.

beats.headline: NEED A WEBSITE LIKE THIS?
beats.action: Resolve to a full-screen cobalt Chronolyte AI contact page. Keep www.chronolyteai.site and +1 (812) 690-6121 together, large and centered for at least three seconds.
